description: Limitations de circulations des routes départementales - Département du Territoire de Belfort is a dataset listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by BUREAU DE RECHERCHES GÉOLOGIQUES ET MINIÈRES. - height limitation: Signed by panel B12, it must be 0.20 to 0.30 m below the actual minimum height of the structure or a gantry. All passages where the clear height above any point of the carriageway normally measured at that point is less than 4.30 m shall be marked. Coverage: FR. The portal shows the English title as "Traffic restrictions on departmental roads - Department of the Territory of Belfort" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include transports de marchandises polluantes, limitation de circulation, routes départementales, transports de matières dangereuses, tonnages limités, hauteurs limitées. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
